predictor_boundary.static: own card, public card, legal actions, current hand history, pot, amount to call, round, and seat
predictor_boundary.temporal_extension: prior opponent actions only; cumulative context rates, entropy, recency, and smoothed response estimates
predictor_boundary.excluded: hidden PCC weights, component scores, action probabilities, outcomes, future cards, and actual opponent private cards

trajectory_control_score.definition: mean held-out log p_temporal(action) minus log p_static(action)

warning: Synthetic identifiability does not establish that human players possess a PCC Control state.

design.split_unit: complete mixture_id; both seats remain in one partition
